verdict.rationale: Penpot's hosted instance serves a machine-readable OpenAPI 3.0.0 document for its backend RPC API at /api/main/doc/openapi.json. It has 152 paths, is auto-generated from source, and is version-tracked to the release, with a Swagger UI that loads the live spec. The probe 404s were on the help.penpot.app docs host, not the API host, so they do not contradict this. Missing for 10: the help docs link the static reference rather than the OpenAPI document, so the spec is not prominently surfaced; on self-hosted instances it is gated behind the enable-backend-api-doc flag; and there is no independent hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can download a machine-readable API spec (OpenAPI or equivalent)

citations.quote: Penpot's hosted SaaS instance serves a machine-readable OpenAPI 3.0.0 document for the backend RPC API (152 paths, server design.penpot.app/api/main/methods).
The hosted instance serves a Swagger UI page ("MAIN API") that loads the live OpenAPI document from /api/main/doc/openapi.json.
the backend API documentation, generated automatically from source code, as a guide
